settled from the vulnerable source (commit cfb872b): executeAdbCommand interpolates the caller-controlled deviceId unescaped as `-s ${deviceId}` into a child_process.exec shell string, so every tool that forwards a caller-supplied deviceId (spread via deviceSelectionParams) or interpolates another user argument reaches the injection: 26 of the 30 tools. The four that take no caller input into the shell (get-devices, help, kill-server, start-server) do not. Record A's 13 counted only tools with a non-deviceId argument; record B's 30 included the four input-free tools.
